scope: Label-free representation-capacity test only; no infection/receptor labels or model fitting

clustering_and_search.other_defaults: Effective MMseqs18 defaults retained in logs; not paper-listed15.6f452

protein_normalization: Remove exactly one terminal stop; reject non-standard20 or empty sequences; reject duplicate IDs within a proteome; neutral IDs preserve source order
family_assignment: Frozen protein_features best-hit parser: float32 identity descending, E-value ascending, raw-first ties; search all training proteins; record cross-family ties
vocabulary: Within-protein 5-mers conditioned on self-search assigned family, count each member once per protein; retain >=2 distinct training proteins; merge exact training-genome occurrence tuples across all retained family/k-mer members
threshold_rationale: Pinned upstream assignment CLI default, not chosen using biological feature results
projection: Reached-family denominator, union of matched family/k-mer members per feature, matching fraction >=0.5; explicit all-zero rows when no members reached
controls: Reproject both source hosts with self-search assignments; require exact training occurrence vectors and nonempty vocabulary before creating target query DB
freeze: Hash training proteins, clusters, self-search, vocabulary and implementation before target query DB/search
interpretation: All-three target distinction is a necessary capacity diagnostic, not a host-range score. Any collision constrains this particular encoder. No stock equivalence or unseen-host-group claim.
adaptations: Exact tuple merging rather than unchecked hash merging
Strict standard20 inputs on uniform existing calls
This declared family-aware training variant is not the prior global ignore_families workflow or a certified full upstream replication
failure_rule: Preserve failed controls/collisions; no threshold or assignment retuning in this run; no interaction model or original benchmark admission
